title: Simple Encounter Turns Into Complete Chaos
description:
This teenager did something that provoked the officers real bad. The officers thought it’d be best to talk to the teenager. Little did they know how explosive he was. This is where the boy’s behavior really pissed off the cops. The neighbors came out in support of the teen. They were not happy to see him get arrested. The boy was clearly not having a good time. He explained to the cops why he had to run away. The boy’s story was mostly clear to the officers, so they prepared to take him to the police department for further processing. The lady continued yelling at the cops for their behavior. The boy was charged with battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
